title: Compile changing-dual junctions: allowance 288 to 224, with safe composition
body:
Replace a common-row, changing-dual exchange junction by three block shears. The named complete two-consumer scalar wrapper costs 288→224 (26→20 emitted ADD/SCALE instructions), after cancelling the baseline's adjacent signs. Raw emissions cost 292. Both outer exchanges and both inner calls remain. Also prove nonlinear composition, exact matching boundaries and the universal safe-observer condition O S=O (linear D=CB). New beyond #6280: the priced junction, nonlinear/observer contracts and independent verification.

Base: 2485805a6d47f36ea83ddde6327d453ac82d44dc.
#6280 source: 4d6e4374d6fdda7df72ddeb19dd6756353383346. Unchanged compiler byte/blob pins: ORIGIN.json; actual caller tariff: SOURCES.json.

Reproduce (Python 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/dual-exchange-independent-audit
```
Expected: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

Executed: eight normal/-O commands; source-emitter and free-block identities; 54 junction factorization comparisons; independent 2000 nonlinear transition cases and exhaustive 59049 F3 composition cases; exact prefix bound and all input columns. Controls catch missing restoration, wrong pairs, invalid observers, 65-bit differences, coefficient-cap overflow and actual source corruption. A valid unfavorable junction costs 212 versus 132, so improvement is cost-tested, not uniform. Source/history/modes, export and unchanged read-only Git-free replay pass. Fixed finite domains and stopping rules are documented; no random seed. Universal proofs are separate.

No new κ. No actual P104 interval or favorable complete supplier invoice is supplied. Inner calls, observers, transport, native work, restoration, precision and storage remain payable. Exact endpoint equality does not certify a rounded implementation; all five framework assumptions remain.

By @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance: worker D construction, worker A independent proof/replay, and lead review. Credit Nick Petalas (#6280), Ali Romman (#5611, #5602), Chris R/Clear1nsight and retained lineage. No human/proof-kernel acceptance.

Proof, exact pins, controls and limits: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/a2d6b3920abb26f22b61b776088209e09b03590e/research/dual-exchange-independent-audit
Complete remote Git tree matches the tested contribution.
